ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LIGHT_ENERGY.title: Light Energy
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LIGHT_ENERGY.descr: Comes in Forest, Thunder, Water, and Fire. Some cards spend Light Energy for bonus effects; if you cannot pay, the bonus does not trigger. Each spent point creates a matching Attribute Cell in the Conversion bar.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ATTRIBUTE_CELL.des:
Each Attribute Cell grants +4% damage for its element.
Fire: For every 4 Fire Attribute Cells, each instance of Fire damage applies 1 Scorch.
Water: For every 4 Water Attribute Cells, heal 1 HP at turn end.
Forest: For every 4 Forest Attribute Cells, gain Block equal to hand size × 1 at turn end.
Thunder: For every 4 Thunder Attribute Cells, each instance of Thunder damage applies 1 Paralysis.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISMATIC.title: Prismatic
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISMATIC.descript: Prismatic Light Energy counts as any element. Prismatic Attribute Cells count as any attribute. Prismatic damage gains all attribute bonuses and triggers Fire and Thunder special effects.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_RAINBOW_LIGHT.desc: Triggers when the Conversion bar has all 4 attributes. This turn, each Attribute Cell grants all damage +8%. If all 4 attributes are present and each has at least 2 cells, this bonus is doubled. At turn end, deal slot-cap × 5 damage to all enemies and reset all Attribute Cells.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISM_CELL.title: Prism Cell
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISM_CELL.descrip: Adjacent cells count as the same attribute.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DARK_CELL.title: Dark Cell
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ENHANCED_CELL.desc: Provides a bonus effect for a specific card.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LOCK.title: Lock
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LOCK.description: Cards deal +5% damage per stack of Lock to locked enemies.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_TIMELESS_SEAL.desc: A stackable mark. Some effects scale with its stacks.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_AURORA_MOMENT.desc: Whenever you spend [blue]15[/blue] Light Energy, cards in your hand cost 0 this turn and gain Ethereal this turn.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FLYING.title: Flying
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FLYING.description: Attacks deal 50% less damage to you. Lose 1 stack at the start of turn.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_WATER.title: Water
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_THUNDER.title: Thunder
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FIRE.title: Fire
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HIGH_COURT_GUARD.d: If you have another High Court Guard in hand when played, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FOREST.title: Forest
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAST_RUPTURE.title: Past Rupture
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAST_RUPTURE.descr: While in hand, whenever the Conversion bar produces 1 Forest cell, this card's damage increases by 1 for the rest of the run.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CRYSTALLIZATION_DO: While in hand, unblocked Forest Attack cards apply 1 Crystallization.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CRYSTALLIZATION.de: At the end of enemy turn, lose 1% Max HP per stack.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_WORD_ABSOLUTE.desc: While in hand, Enhanced Cells you gain are absorbed. Each absorbed cell reduces this card's cost by 1 this combat.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SHADOW_TOWN_TEA_PA: After playing a Tea Party member, the next Tea Party member costs 1 less. Has a cooldown.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_THORN_SEAL_ON_BODY: This card's damage increases by 1 for each Retain effect triggered this combat.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_RADIANT_BLOOM.desc: Each time this card is played, its values increase by 1 for the rest of the run.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DISPLACEMENT_KING_: On the turn after playing, your Forest damage bonus becomes Block bonus.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_EMERALD_MARK.title: Emerald Mark
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAPER_WOUND.title: Paper Wound
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAPER_WOUND.descri: Each stack reduces Max HP by 2 when damage is taken.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HARVEST_CONSCIOUSN: Each stack lets 10% damage bypass Block. Above 10 stacks, increases damage by 10% instead.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NORTHERN_REALM.des: Each Water card gains 1 Replay the first time it is played this combat.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_POISON_FLOWER_POOL: Attribute Cells created when this card spends Light Energy are always Dark Cells.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ON_CAPITAL.title: On Capital
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ON_CAPITAL.descrip: On first play, bind Capital Tax: pay Gold when this card is drawn; each payment increases damage. Gold is refunded on victory.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DIVINE_HAND.title: Divine Hand
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DIVINE_HAND.descri: Choose cards from your Draw pile to add to your hand.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SLEEPWALK.title: Sleepwalk
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SLEEPWALK.descript: Exhaust this card after playing; return it to your hand after several turns.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_MIRROR_BLOOM.title: Mirror Bloom
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_MIRROR_BLOOM.descr: Transform cards in your Draw pile into Water cards.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NIGHTMARE_THORN.de: Each debuff stack on an enemy increases your final damage against it by 2%.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DRAGON_FANG_MARK.d: Each stack increases final damage against this target by 2%.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FRANK_CLAW.title: Frank Claw
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FRANK_CLAW.descrip: Each stack makes the target lose equal HP when attacked.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_VELVET_NEEDLE.desc: At turn end, burst: deal 1 Water damage per stack and heal the applier for 1 HP per stack.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SLOW.title: Slow
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_AWAKENING_FORM.des: Whenever you spend 15 Light Energy, reset the Conversion bar with 4 different Attributes.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SOARING.title: Soar
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SOARING.descriptio: Whenever the Light Energy Attribute you spend differs from the last, draw 1 card.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_IGNITION.title: Ignition
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_IGNITION.descripti: Amplify your next Fire damage by 20%, then lose 1 stack.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BLOOMING_BEGONIA.d: Ignition amplifies Fire damage by an additional 20%.
Each time you play this card this combat, Scorch applied is doubled.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SUPREME_CODEX.desc: After playing, upgrade 1 random card at the end of this combat.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SHADOW_HERD_MAJEST: On play, draw 2 Fire Attack cards from your draw pile.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BABA_YAGA_COCOON.d: On play, lose 7% current HP as Plating boosted by Fire cells, and gain Energy.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DRAGON_BREATH_ROAR: On play, Exhaust all Statuses; each adds 5% final damage.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_INVESTMENT_RISK.de: On play, Exhaust the bottom card of your draw pile, then draw the top card.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CLEAR_ALL.title: Clear All!
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CLEAR_ALL.descript: Spend all Light Energy and fill the Conversion bar with random Dark cells.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HIGH_NOON.title: High Noon
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HIGH_NOON.descript: Whenever drawn, load 1 bullet per card in your Exhaust pile.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NO_SURVIVORS.title: No Survivors
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NO_SURVIVORS.descr: Spends all Ignition; each stack adds 10% damage.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DEAD_CELEBRATION.d: Shuffle all Exhausted cards into discard and give them Ethereal.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BOX_MELODY.title: Box Melody
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BOX_MELODY.descrip: Generate 1 random 0-cost card for each player.
